import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from fig_style import apply_style
apply_style()

# --- Data ---
# 008d s1 (Pathway A — CIVO)
steps_008d = np.array([25000, 35000, 45000, 55000])
eval_008d = np.array([167.22, 146.34, 140.80, 82.75])
value_008d = np.array([25.86, 60.20, 97.50, 137.88])
entropy_008d = np.array([-3.47, -3.91, -4.35, -4.88])

# exp_080 / 008e_v3 s1 (dt=1 imagination — no CIVO)
steps_080 = np.array([5000, 15000, 25000, 35000, 45000, 55000, 65000, 75000, 85000, 95000, 105000])
eval_080 = np.array([31.00, 104.88, 369.35, 404.96, 511.60, 690.31, 731.28, 846.47, 803.76, 848.61, 876.69])
value_080 = np.array([0.00, 3.89, 24.33, 88.37, 160.58, 230.51, 307.24, 386.44, 451.87, 515.48, 548.06])
entropy_080 = np.array([8.165, 1.824, 1.012, -1.501, -3.609, -4.689, -4.605, -4.873, -4.866, -4.981, -5.041])

# 009a baseline s2 (Control)
steps_baseline = np.array([5000, 15000, 25000, 35000, 45000, 55000, 65000, 75000, 85000, 95000, 105000])
eval_baseline = np.array([41.21, 106.01, 325.33, 354.49, 498.01, 534.13, 688.87, 656.85, 618.73, 596.24, 836.51])
value_baseline_sparse = {5000: 0, 25000: 45.78, 55000: 253.49, 105000: 539.34}

# Interpolate baseline value for smooth line
vb_steps = np.array(sorted(value_baseline_sparse.keys()))
vb_values = np.array([value_baseline_sparse[s] for s in vb_steps])

# Colors
C_MAIN = '#D55E00'
C_BASE = '#999999'
C_COLLAPSE_BG = '#FFCCCC'
C_HEALTHY = '#27AE60'

# Convert steps to K for display
def to_k(steps):
    return steps / 1000

# --- Figure ---
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
gs = gridspec.GridSpec(3, 2, hspace=0.38, wspace=0.32,
                       top=0.88, bottom=0.11, left=0.09, right=0.97)

row_labels = ['Eval Return', 'Value Mean', 'Actor Entropy']

# Column titles
fig.text(0.295, 0.945, 'Pathway A: CIVO (008d s1)', ha='center', va='bottom',
         fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=C_MAIN)
fig.text(0.295, 0.925, r'$dt{=}2$ imagination, trained $dt$-emb  |  NVE = 4.13',
         ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10, color='#555555')

fig.text(0.745, 0.945, 'No CIVO ($dt{=}1$ imag, 008e_v3 s1)', ha='center', va='bottom',
         fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=C_HEALTHY)
fig.text(0.745, 0.925, r'$dt{=}1$ imagination, trained $dt$-emb  |  NVE $\leq$ 0.6$\times$',
         ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10, color='#555555')

# ============================================================
# Column A (left) — 008d s1
# ============================================================

# Baseline clipped to Pathway A range for reference
mask_bl_a = (steps_baseline >= 25000) & (steps_baseline <= 55000)
steps_bl_a = steps_baseline[mask_bl_a]
eval_bl_a = eval_baseline[mask_bl_a]

# --- Row 1: Eval Return ---
ax_a1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
ax_a1.plot(to_k(steps_bl_a), eval_bl_a, '--', color=C_BASE, linewidth=1.5, label='009a baseline', zorder=1)
ax_a1.plot(to_k(steps_008d), eval_008d, '-o', color=C_MAIN, markersize=5, label='008d s1', zorder=2)
ax_a1.axvspan(to_k(35000), to_k(55000), alpha=0.12, color='red', zorder=0)
ax_a1.set_ylabel('Eval Return')
ax_a1.set_xlim(22, 58)
ax_a1.legend(loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9)
# Annotation: eval decline arrow
ax_a1.annotate('eval decline',
               xy=(55, 82.75), xytext=(38, 60),
               fontsize=9, color='#B00000', fontweight='bold',
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#B00000', lw=1.5),
               ha='center')

# --- Row 2: Value Mean ---
ax_a2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
# baseline value sparse points in range
mask_vb_a = (vb_steps >= 25000) & (vb_steps <= 55000)
ax_a2.plot(to_k(vb_steps[mask_vb_a]), vb_values[mask_vb_a], '--', color=C_BASE, linewidth=1.5, label='009a baseline', zorder=1)
ax_a2.plot(to_k(steps_008d), value_008d, '-o', color=C_MAIN, markersize=5, label='008d s1', zorder=2)
ax_a2.axvspan(to_k(35000), to_k(55000), alpha=0.12, color='red', zorder=0)
ax_a2.set_ylabel('Value Mean')
ax_a2.set_xlim(22, 58)
ax_a2.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9)
# Annotation: value explosion
ax_a2.annotate('value explosion\n(+130%)',
               xy=(55, 137.88), xytext=(38, 155),
               fontsize=9, color='#B00000', fontweight='bold',
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#B00000', lw=1.5),
               ha='center')

# --- Row 3: Actor Entropy ---
ax_a3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax_a3.plot(to_k(steps_008d), entropy_008d, '-o', color=C_MAIN, markersize=5, label='008d s1', zorder=2)
ax_a3.axvspan(to_k(35000), to_k(55000), alpha=0.12, color='red', zorder=0)
ax_a3.set_ylabel('Actor Entropy')
ax_a3.set_xlabel('Training Steps (K)')
ax_a3.set_xlim(22, 58)
ax_a3.legend(loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9)
# Light annotation for entropy direction
ax_a3.annotate('entropy $\\downarrow$\n(over-committed)',
               xy=(50, -4.55), xytext=(32, -3.3),
               fontsize=9, color='#B00000', fontweight='bold',
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#B00000', lw=1.5),
               ha='center')

# ============================================================
# Column B (right) — exp_080 / 008e_v3 s1 (dt=1 imagination, no CIVO)
# ============================================================

# --- Row 1: Eval Return ---
ax_b1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_b1.plot(to_k(steps_baseline), eval_baseline, '--', color=C_BASE, linewidth=1.5, label='009a baseline', zorder=1)
ax_b1.plot(to_k(steps_080), eval_080, '-o', color=C_HEALTHY, markersize=4, label='080 s1', zorder=2)
ax_b1.set_ylabel('Eval Return')
ax_b1.set_xlim(0, 110)
ax_b1.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9)
ax_b1.annotate('876.7 (94% baseline)',
               xy=(105, 876.69), xytext=(65, 930),
               fontsize=9, color='#1a7a3a', fontweight='bold',
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#1a7a3a', lw=1.5),
               ha='center')

# --- Row 2: Value Mean ---
ax_b2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax_b2.plot(to_k(vb_steps), vb_values, '--', color=C_BASE, linewidth=1.5, label='009a baseline', zorder=1)
ax_b2.plot(to_k(steps_080), value_080, '-o', color=C_HEALTHY, markersize=4, label='080 s1', zorder=2)
ax_b2.set_ylabel('Value Mean')
ax_b2.set_xlim(0, 110)
ax_b2.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9)
ax_b2.annotate(r'NVE $\leq$ 0.6$\times$' + '\n(calibrated)',
               xy=(105, 548.06), xytext=(65, 580),
               fontsize=9, color='#1a7a3a', fontstyle='italic',
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#1a7a3a', lw=1.2),
               ha='center')

# --- Row 3: Actor Entropy ---
ax_b3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
ax_b3.plot(to_k(steps_080), entropy_080, '-o', color=C_HEALTHY, markersize=4, label='080 s1', zorder=2)
ax_b3.set_ylabel('Actor Entropy')
ax_b3.set_xlabel('Training Steps (K)')
ax_b3.set_xlim(0, 110)
ax_b3.legend(loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9)
ax_b3.annotate('entropy $\\downarrow$\n(normal convergence)',
               xy=(85, -4.87), xytext=(40, -2.5),
               fontsize=9, color='#555555', fontstyle='italic',
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#888888', lw=1.2),
               ha='center')

# ============================================================
# Bottom shared note
# ============================================================
fig.text(0.5, 0.005,
         'Both configurations use trained $dt$-embedding  '
         r'|  CIVO onset requires $dt > 1$ imagination (F6)',
         ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontstyle='italic', color='#444444')

# ============================================================
# Save
# ============================================================
out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_9/projects/event-gated-adaptive-horizon/artifacts/figures/paper'
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig6_multiple_pathways.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig6_multiple_pathways.png')
plt.close()
print('Done.')
